name: A Jersey City rowhouse garden

place_source.title: Wikidata: Jersey City (Q26339), coordinate location (P625) and elevation above sea level (P2044)

blurb: A narrow backyard behind a brownstone row in Jersey City: a postage-stamp lawn, a border of shrubs, a red maple, a flowering dogwood and a holly, busy with cardinals, jays, doves and sparrows by day and visited by skunks and rats after dark.

facts.text: Jersey City has a humid subtropical climate (Köppen Cfa), closely bordering on a humid continental climate (Dfa), with hot, humid summers and cool to cold winters.
